description: This class implements a fixed-size cyclic buffer for storing double values, providing methods to add data, retrieve stored values, and manage buffer state.

classes.name: CyclicBuffer
classes.description: A fixed-size array-backed cyclic buffer for numeric data, implementing DataBuffer interface.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets the buffer by setting size and pointer to zero.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new double value to the buffer, overwriting oldest data if buffer is full.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of values currently stored in the buffer.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Returns a copy of the stored values as an array.

methods.name: getMaxSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum capacity of the buffer.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value at a specific index.
